climate.fall: Generally out of condition; early-season snow can return by October.
climate.spring: Prime season — firm neve typically persists into May.
climate.summer: Melts out and becomes rock/scree by mid-summer in most years.
climate.winter: Can be climbable in stable avalanche conditions but access is a full winter approach.

bySeason.spring: Couloirs often in good condition; manage avalanche risk
bySeason.summer: Couloirs melt out; summer is the scramble season via Aasgard
bySeason.winter: Primary couloir season; cold and avalanche-prone
